scope: Both volumes whole, held for the manuscripts of the Apocalypse (the uncials and the minuscules), the lectionaries, and the printed editions from Erasmus to the received text.
verified_loci: Erasmus's own note, as Scrivener quotes it: words at the end of the book wanting in the Greek, added from the Latin — 'nonnulla verba reperi apud nostros, quae aberant in Graecis exem- plaribus, ea tamen ex latinis adjecimus'
